strategy_a_in_sequence_chronological.description: Allocates the first 70% of chronological observations per sequence to Train and the final 30% to Test.
strategy_a_in_sequence_chronological.leakage_risk: Zero (strictly preserves time-ordering within every train journey)

strategy_b_run_holdout.description: Uses earlier runs as training/development data and the latest collection run (20260822T131216Z-moving-7b8b8e46) as temporal holdout.
strategy_b_run_holdout.leakage_risk: Zero (complete temporal and operational separation across days/sessions)
